channel.title: MFGA Radio
channel.description: Hank and Sal break down the week in a twelve-team best-ball league of Texas Longhorn friends: the winner, the standings, Player of the Week, the Covfefe Award, the Deep State Bench, the Longhorn Desk, the Tariff. Every number is the number on the league page. Nobody sets a lineup. Nobody can be robbed. Parody; the commentary is a joke.
